summary.description: Event title (required unless using natural language query)

start.description: ISO 8601 start time or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day

end.description: ISO 8601 end time or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day (optional, defaults to duration)

account_hint.description: Friendly account selector like work, personal, or an email address

add_google_meet.description: Whether to create the event with a Google Meet link

query.description: Natural language scheduling request (alternative to structured params)
